entries.title: A message answered after a problem is filed with its answer
entries.body: When Firstmate could not answer a message at first, because its provider had a problem or needed you to sign in again, it kept your words and answered them later. Tasks also listed a second, done task for that message that ended in the problem. Now the message is filed once, with its answer.
entries.noPicture: The change is a task Tasks search no longer lists; a picture cannot show what is missing.
